Hi, I'm Herrmann — full name Gabriel Herrmann Grecchi.
Lead AI Engineer · Fullstack & Frontend Specialist, based in Novo Hamburgo, RS — Brazil.
I go by Herrmann — Gabriel Herrmann Grecchi on paper.
Fullstack developer since 2014, mobile since 2017, Web3 and AI since 2020.

Most of my work has been on mission-critical platforms in banking and finance, healthcare and pharma, and SaaS — products with millions of users, strict security and no room for downtime — plus consumer apps for retail, restaurants and gyms.
My specialty is frontend engineering at enterprise scale: Angular architecture, Micro Frontends, design systems, performance and accessibility.
I am just as comfortable on the backend with Python, C#/.
NET, Node.
js and Kotlin integrations, and I lead teams as a Tech Lead when the project needs it.
Today I focus on AI engineering — LLMs, RAG, agentic patterns, evals and fine-tuning — through my own consultancy, Herrmann IT Consultoria.
In 2020 I founded Projeto Dev, a social project that helps people get their first job in tech.
